criteria.name: Market Demand
criteria.description: Measures potential customer demand for the business.

criteria.name: Resource Availability
criteria.description: Measures availability of local resources and raw materials.

criteria.name: Cost Feasibility
criteria.description: Measures whether the business fits the available budget.

criteria.name: Skill Match
criteria.description: Measures how well the entrepreneur's skills match the business.

criteria.name: Competition
criteria.description: Measures the level and strength of existing competition.

criteria.name: Infrastructure
criteria.description: Measures availability of electricity, transportation, storage, internet and other infrastructure.

criteria.name: Growth Potential
criteria.description: Measures potential to expand the business.

criteria.name: Risk
criteria.description: Measures business uncertainty and major risks.
